answer: Proof-of-Stake consensus enforces Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital as collateral, forming a financial ridge that prevents cheap identity proliferation. Each node acts as a dune of locked assets, shifting to secure the network as the dawn of automated participation approaches. An attacker must acquire a majority of the circulating supply to subvert the system, making the cost of creating fake identities proportional to the network's total economic weight rather than computational effort.
